L133: # Welcome to Moonshot AI
L134: 
L135: cite64†Moonshot AI†moonshot.ai is committed to solving ambitious "moonshot" problems that will lead humanity to AGI. We embrace open source, and contributed the following projects to the community:
L136: ## Research
L137:   * cite70†Kimi K3 : Kimi K3 is a 2.8T-parameter model built on Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) and Attention Residuals (AttnRes), with native vision capabilities and a 1-million-token context window. It is the world's first open 3T-class model, designed for frontier intelligence across long-horizon coding, knowledge work, and reasoning.
L138:   * cite71†Attention Residuals : a drop-in replacement for residual connections with consistent scaling gains.
L139:   * cite72†Kimi K2.5 : Kimi K2.5 is an open-source, native multimodal agentic model built through continual pretraining on approximately 15 trillion mixed visual and text tokens atop Kimi-K2-Base.
L140:   * cite73†Kimi Linear : a hybrid linear attention architecture that outperforms traditional full attention methods across various contexts.
L141:   * cite74†Kimi K2 : an open-source Mixture-of-Experts model with 32B activated parameters and 1T total parameters. It achieves state-of-the-art performance in frontier knowledge, math, and coding among non-thinking models.
L142:   * cite75†Kimi-K1.5 : Scaling Reinforcement Learning with LLMs. We released our tech report on building an o1-level multi-modal reasoning model.
L143:   * cite76†Moonlight for our paper cite77†Muon is Scalable for LLM Training†arxiv.org . We released (i) checkpoints for SOTA small models; (ii) code for our improved Muon optimizer.
L144:   * cite78†MoBA : Mixture of Block Attention for Long-Context LLMs. We released code and paper for our looong-context LLM technique.
L145:   * cite79†Kimi-VL : Mixture-of-Experts Vision-Language Model for Multimodal Reasoning, Long-Context Understanding, and Strong Agent Capabilities
L146:   * cite80†Kimina-Prover Preview : Towards Large Formal Reasoning Models with Reinforcement Learning. We released technical report, model weights and a rectified version of miniF2F-test benchmark.
L147:   * cite81†Kimi-Audio : Universal audio foundation model that handles diverse tasks like speech recognition, audio understanding, audio-to-text chat, speech-to-speech conversation. We released the technical report, model weights and evaluation toolkit.
L148: ## Benchmarks
L149: 
L150:   * cite82†WorldVQA : a benchmark measuring atomic vision-centric world knowledge in multimodal large language models.
L151:   * cite83†PerceptionBench : a benchmark for evaluating atomic visual perception in multimodal large language models.
L152:   * cite84†CombiBench : the first benchmark for combinatorial mathematics problems formalized in Lean 4.
L153: 
L154: ## Agents
L155: 
L156:   * cite85†Kimi Code : A fast, versatile, and extensible AI coding agent that brings Kimi into your projects and development workflow.
L157: ## Service and Infra
L158:   * cite86†MoonEP : an expert parallelism communication library that keeps token loads perfectly balanced across ranks via dynamic redundant experts.
L159:   * cite87†FlashKDA : high-performance Kimi Delta Attention kernels built on CUTLASS.
L160:   * cite88†Kimi-Vendor-Verifier : monitoring and verifying the precision of Kimi model APIs across vendors.
L161:   * cite89†checkpoint-engine : efficiently update model weights in LLM serving.
L162:   * cite90†Mooncake : pioneered the idea of KV-centric disaggregated LLM serving, winning the Best Paper award at FAST 2025. We released code and data corresponding to our paper.
L163:   * cite91†moonpalace : debugging tool for our API service.
L164: ## Community
L165: 
L166:   * cite92†Forum†forum.moonshot.ai : join discussions, ask questions, and share ideas about the Moonshot AI platform and APIs.
